title: Keyboard, dialog focus, desktop layout and sustained workload
steps: Use Tab, Shift+Tab and Enter to create a custom game from Home, select squares, save and visit Settings.
Open confirmations and failures; check focus containment, dismissal, return focus and repeated submissions. Resolve a draw explicitly.
Inspect the long game and snapshot names, nested history and save details at 1440×900 and 1024×768, 75/100/150%, both board orientations and light/dark themes.
Repeat history navigation, library/settings routes, dialog dismissal and engine add/stop/remove for 12 cycles with 160 legal plies and 32 named snapshots; record timings and resource counts.
